title: Shar's Spear of Evening
summary: Legendary +3 spear with Blind immunity, benefits from obscurity, and repeatable Darkness.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d6 + 3 Piercing one-handed or 1d8 + 3 two-handed, plus Strength. +3 to attack. Simple, versatile, thrown, dippable, 5 ft melee.
fields.Shar’s Blessing: The tooltip describes advantage on saves while obscured. The source reports Dexterity saves only. Weapon attacks gain 1d6 damage against obscured creatures, including attacks made with another weapon.
fields.Blind Immunity: Cannot be Blinded and can see through magical Darkness.
fields.Shar’s Darkness: Level 2 Action, 60 ft, once per turn. Creates a 17 ft radius heavily obscuring cloud for up to 10 turns with Concentration. It blinds creatures inside and blocks ranged attacks into or out of the cloud.
fields.Rush Attack: Action with proficiency, once per Short Rest. Charge up to 30 ft and strike first non-allied creature or object for 1d4 + attack ability modifier Piercing. Strength save vs weapon-action DC avoids Off Balance for 2 turns. Off Balance gives disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity checks and advantage to attackers. Help or damage ends it.
fields.Maiming Strike: Action with proficiency, once per Short Rest. Melee attack for 1d4 + attack ability modifier Piercing. Constitution save vs weapon-action DC +2 avoids Maimed for 2 turns. Flying creatures cannot be Maimed. Maimed stops movement and gives disadvantage on Dexterity saves. Healing removes it.
fields.Acquisition: Bring Shadowheart and the Spear of Night into Shadowfell, then kill Nightsong as part of The Chosen of Shar.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
